# cargoship_cluster_facts

Reads what cargoship can learn about a fleet without changing it: each host's operating system, architecture, hostname, private address, and the engine version it is running. It runs the five read-only phases of an apply (`Connect`, `DetectOS`, `GatherFacts`, `GatherFactsDistro`, `Disconnect`), takes no cluster lock, and writes nothing to any host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cargoship_cluster_facts" "fleet" {
  name          = "fleet-facts"
  load_balancer = "10.0.0.10"
  distro        = "k3s"

  host {
    address  = "10.0.0.11"
    role     = "controller"
    key_path = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
  }
}

output "installed_versions" {
  value = { for n in data.cargoship_cluster_facts.fleet.nodes : n.hostname => n.engine_version }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `distro` (String) The engine to read: `k3s` or `rke2`. It is what tells cargoship which version string to look for on each host.
- `load_balancer` (String) The address clients use to reach the control plane. Nothing is contacted through it here -- the facts are read over SSH -- but the cluster document requires it.
- `name` (String) The cluster's name. It becomes `metadata.name` in the cluster document cargoship reads.

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (List of Object) What was read back, one entry per host block, in the same order.

### Nested Blocks

#### `host` (List Block)

A host to read. Controllers are read first whatever order the blocks are in, because that is the order an apply uses.

| Attribute         | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `address`         | `String` | Required | The address or hostname cargoship opens an SSH connection to.                                                                                                                      |
| `hostname`        | `String` | Optional | The name the host is known by before it has been visited.                                                                                                                          |
| `key_path`        | `String` | Optional | Path to the SSH private key on the machine running OpenTofu. There is no attribute for key material, and there will not be: a key in the configuration is a key in the state file. |
| `port`            | `Number` | Optional | The SSH port. Defaults to 22.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `private_address` | `String` | Optional | Overrides the private address the facts phase would discover.                                                                                                                      |
| `profile`         | `String` | Optional | The profile this host selects from the cluster's profile map.                                                                                                                      |
| `role`            | `String` | Required | The host's role: one of `controller`, `controller+worker`, `single`, `worker`.                                                                                                     |
| `user`            | `String` | Optional | The SSH user. Defaults to `root`.                                                                                                                                                  |
